checks.sentence: Contracts are won through a competitive tender process that follows a standard pattern across government infrastructure work. The client floats a tender, a pre-bid meeting is held to resolve queries, contractors submit bids based on their eligibility, and the job is awarded to the lowest quote. The winning contractor then deposits a performance guarantee before receiving the drawings and site handover for execution.

checks.note: All figures match the excerpt order (FY2018 to FY2014).
checks.sentence: Revenue from operations peaked at ₹9,021.12 lakhs (₹90.21 crore) in FY2015 and then declined steadily to ₹6,053.05 lakhs (₹60.53 crore) in FY2018, a drop of about 33% over three years. The intervening years show the trajectory: ₹7,452.76 lakhs in FY2016, ₹7,344.47 lakhs in FY2017, and then the sharper fall to ₹6,053.05 lakhs in FY2018.

Net profit after adjustments has been erratic. It stood at ₹95.95 lakhs in FY2014, fell to ₹78.36 lakhs in FY2015, dropped further to ₹32.63 lakhs in FY2016, and hit a low of ₹15.86 lakhs in FY2017. Then came a sharp recovery to ₹314.66 lakhs in FY2018 — a nearly 20-fold jump from the previous year.

checks.note: Lack of independent appraisal and monitoring agency confirmed.
checks.sentence: No independent appraisal or monitoring of fund use. The company has not appointed an independent agency to appraise the project for which IPO funds are being raised, nor has it appointed a monitoring agency to track deployment. Fund deployment will be monitored by the Audit Committee, which is an internal body. This reduces the external oversight that investors might expect when their money is being used for a specific stated purpose.
